errors.text: The proposed Mg-Al-Cr-Fe-(Mn/Cu) composition does not reconstruct the MgAlTiVFeCo system or its ball-milled BCC initial state.
It places the optimum at 850–900 °C and asserts failure above 950 °C, whereas the target optimum is SPS at 1000 °C and magnesium-volatility exclusion begins only above the specified 1000 °C boundary.
The proposed diffusion-catalyst mechanism omits the target mediator: uniformly distributed AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 barrier phases and the resulting continuous passive film.
The falsification experiment excludes the critical 1000 °C comparator and does not measure oxidation at 900 °C or biphasic parabolic oxidation-rate constants.
The cited evidence does not directly support Mn or Cu lowering diffusion activation energy, suppressing Mg volatility, or producing a single BCC Mg-based alloy in the stated temperature range.
